newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico seeks bidders for wireless spectrum auction.
newsitem.headline: Mexico seeks bidders for wireless spectrum auction.

text.p: Mexico is inviting domestic and international bidders to take part in wireless spectrum auctions scheduled for this October, advisors J.P. Morgan Securities said on Thursday.

"The government of the United States of Mexico...is seeking national and international investors to participate in wireless spectrum auctions for Personal Coommunications Services and Wireless Local Loop," the advisors said in a statement released in Mexico City.
The auctions are being organised by Mexico's telecoms regulator, the Federal Telecommunications Commission (COFETEL), and will be conducted via simultaneous multiple rounds, it said.
It said the available frequencies were 1850-1990 Mhz, 3.4-3.7 Ghz, and 440-450 and 485-495 Mhz.
Auction terms will be published June 30. Bidders must submit qualification documents September 17 to 19 and will be notified of qualification on October 6.
The auction itself will begin on October 20.
